dataconv.name: Data Converter
dataconv.short: Convert CSV, JSON and Excel files.
dataconv.title: CSV, JSON & Excel Converter – Free Online, No Upload | {brand}
dataconv.desc: Convert between CSV, TSV, JSON, Excel (XLSX/XLS) and ODS in your browser. Nested JSON, multi-sheet Excel, Unicode safe.
steps: Select CSV, JSON or Excel files.

csv2json.name: CSV to JSON
csv2json.title: CSV to JSON Converter – Free, Private, Instant | {brand}
csv2json.desc: Convert CSV to a JSON array with automatic number/boolean detection and nested objects from dot.keys. Runs in your browser.

faq.a: The first row becomes the JSON keys. A header like address.city becomes a nested object.

json2csv.name: JSON to CSV
json2csv.title: JSON to CSV Converter – Free Online, No Upload | {brand}
json2csv.desc: Convert JSON arrays to CSV. Nested objects are flattened to dot.keys; opens cleanly in Excel (UTF-8 BOM).

csv2excel.name: CSV to Excel
csv2excel.short: Convert CSV into an XLSX workbook.
csv2excel.title: CSV to Excel Converter – CSV to XLSX Free | {brand}
csv2excel.desc: Convert CSV files to Excel XLSX with proper numbers and Unicode text. Free, no upload.

excel2csv.name: Excel to CSV
excel2csv.title: Excel to CSV Converter – XLSX to CSV Free | {brand}
excel2csv.desc: Convert XLSX, XLS and ODS spreadsheets to CSV – one file per sheet. Runs in your browser.

excel2json.name: Excel to JSON
excel2json.title: Excel to JSON Converter – XLSX to JSON Free | {brand}
excel2json.desc: Convert Excel sheets to JSON arrays using the first row as keys. Free and private.

json2excel.name: JSON to Excel
json2excel.short: Turn JSON data into a spreadsheet.
json2excel.title: JSON to Excel Converter – JSON to XLSX Free | {brand}
json2excel.desc: Convert JSON arrays to Excel XLSX. Nested fields become dot.key columns.
